---
title: "AutoDockFR (ADFR)"
---

AutoDockFR docks small molecules into receptors, with explicitly specified flexibility of binding-site side chains.

::: {.callout-note}
This page is being moved from the CCSB website. Until then, overview, downloads, documentation
and tutorials are at **[ccsb.scripps.edu/adfr](https://ccsb.scripps.edu/adfr/)**.
:::
